notes: Synchronous calls: user is a gRPC server (services/user/server.go:67 grpc.NewServer, line 69 pb.RegisterUserServer, method CheckUser at line 91). It makes no gRPC or HTTP client call to another hotel service: no dialer import and no pb client in services/user/server.go or cmd/user/main.go. Its only outbound synchronous dependency is MongoDB: cmd/user/main.go:38 initializeDatabase(result["UserMongoAddress"]) with UserMongoAddress mongodb-user:27017 (config.json:25); db.go:39-43 mongo.Connect on mongodb://<url>; server.go:46 loadUsers(s.MongoClient) reads the whole user-db.user collection once at startup (server.go:112 collection.Find). CheckUser (server.go:91-107) answers from the in-memory map s.users, no per-request database call. The initializeDatabase name implies seeding, and db.go:50 InsertMany does insert test users on every start; the seeding call is not commented out in main.go:38 (only the earlier line 21 initializeDatabase() is commented). Protocol of the database edge: MongoDB wire protocol via go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver (db.go:10).
Messages: no topics, producers, consumers or consumer groups in these files.

Registry: registers with consul. cmd/user/main.go:58 registry.NewClient(*consulAddr), consulAddress consul:8500 (config.json:2), overridable by flag -consuladdr (main.go:46). services/user/server.go:76 s.Registry.Register(name, s.uuid, s.IpAddr, s.Port) with name = srv-user (server.go:23), called once in Run() after net.Listen and before srv.Serve(lis) (server.go:82); Deregister on Shutdown (server.go:87). UserIP is not in config.json (UserPort is, line 24), so servIP is empty (main.go:42) and Register falls back to getLocalIP (registry/registry.go:79-80). The AgentServiceRegistration (registry/registry.go:85-90) sets only ID, Name, Port, Address: no Check, TTL, interval or DeregisterCriticalServiceAfter. Heartbeat interval, failure timeout and cleanup interval: not stated in these files (library default, not in these files; the consul agent config is not among the files). No goroutine or call in user code refreshes the registration, so no heartbeat running independently of request processing is stated in these files. The gRPC server sets keepalive Timeout 120s (server.go:53) and PermitWithoutStream (server.go:56); that is gRPC transport keepalive, not registry liveness.

Container, replicas, health check: upstream compose service user (docker-compose.yml:178), build: . (line 187), image deathstarbench/hotel-reservation:latest (line 188), entrypoint user (line 189), replicas: 1 (line 195), restart: always (line 193). Harness compose overrides the image to obsplacement-hotel-reservation:6ecb09706140 (compose.observability-placement.yml:38, default of HR_APP_IMAGE). The Dockerfile (lines 1-19) only builds binaries with go install ./cmd/.... No health check in the files given: no HEALTHCHECK in the Dockerfile and no healthcheck key in either compose file. depends_on mongodb-user and consul (upstream compose lines 191-192).

Telemetry: traces only. Jaeger agent address jaeger:6831 (config.json:3, jaegerAddress, read at cmd/user/main.go:45, passed to tracing.Init at main.go:51 as LocalAgentHostPort, tracing/tracer.go:37). Reporter BufferFlushInterval 1 * time.Second (tracing/tracer.go:36). Sampler probabilistic, default ratio 0.01 (tracing/tracer.go:14), overridden by env JAEGER_SAMPLE_RATIO (tracer.go:20); harness compose sets JAEGER_SAMPLE_RATIO from ${HR_JAEGER_SAMPLE_RATIO:-1} (line 40) and JAEGER_DISABLED from ${HR_JAEGER_DISABLED:-false} (line 41); cfg.FromEnv() at tracer.go:42. Spans come from the gRPC server interceptor otgrpc.OpenTracingServerInterceptor (server.go:59); no manual spans in user code. Logs: zerolog ConsoleWriter to os.Stdout (cmd/user/main.go:22), level from LOG_LEVEL default info (tune/setting.go:19), no log exporter. Metrics: none stated in these files.
